llms.summary: Israeli law firm (offices in Tel Aviv / Ramat Gan and Jerusalem) practising citizenship by descent, immigration and notarial law. Best known for German and Austrian citizenship restoration for descendants of people persecuted by the Nazi regime (German Basic Law Art. 116(2), StAG §5; Austrian Citizenship Act §58c).
